symptom: Expanded process text is darker and bolder than its heading; mouse summary has UA focus; zero retries adds noise.
direct_cause: Receipt/Markdown descendants independently set foreground and weight; summaries omit focus-visible; one translation always prints retries.
class_root: Process container and summary projection do not own their presentation invariants.
affected_population: All v4 process groups, receipts and both locales

external_sources.purpose: Preserve keyboard focus while removing pointer focus outline.

invariants: Process ordinary text uses ink-60 and normal weight; semantic status/time/icon styling is preserved.
All three summaries retain keyboard-only accent outlines.
Zero retries is omitted; positive retry counts remain localized.
generality_proof: Container-scoped descendant rules cover nested receipts and Markdown regardless of producer, without changing standalone receipts. All summaries share one focus class. All completed processes use the same count-based translation selection.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own nested process tone and weight
Own all three summary focus styles
Select complete localized summary according to retry count

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Nested groups render V4ToolReceipt within V4Process.
Direct and nested receipt details converge on process-scoped styles; standalone receipt tone remains outside scope.
Every completed work stretch computes retries and chooses summary here.

recurrence.reason: Any repeated tool call or Markdown process can recreate the hierarchy inversion.
same_class_scan: rg summary/font-medium/text-nomi-ink across AgentPanelV4Receipt.tsx: all three summary variants inspected.
Read NomiMarkdown.tsx: paragraphs, headings, strong, table cells and technical details override inherited ink.
rg processSummary across src: collapse projection plus both locales.

prevention.invariant: Process descendants cannot independently raise neutral text emphasis.
prevention.failure_mode: Container selector specificity overrides nested neutral colors and bold weight; no producer can opt out.
prevention.strategy: Own the hierarchy at the process container, focus at a shared class and retries at the collapse projection.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace unscoped process emphasis and unconditional retry summary in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change is needed for a CSS presentation invariant; preserve native keyboard behavior.
exit_criteria: If a Chromium upgrade fails the mouse/Tab walkthrough, re-evaluate its focus heuristic before upgrading.

migration: No persisted data or public protocol changes.
residual_risks: Only the two requested themes and native Electron summary behavior are validated.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The container is the earliest common visual ancestor; computed-style tests exercise its actual rendered output.
